subject: SOURCE clause
notes: "SOURCE and SOURCES are synonyms." (cite.py --check 13.18.53.3 OK SR1). Both spellings reach the same production and the binder never reads which was written; conformance:cases/13.18.14-COLUMN/pb1221_report_keyword_prefixes writes SOURCES ARE and SOURCE IS in one report line with identical placement. The synonymy is of MEANING: each spelling keeps the connective its format alternative prints ({SOURCE IS | SOURCES ARE}, 13.18.53.2), so SOURCE ARE and SOURCES IS are refused by the parser (kb/Work PB1221).
